title: Generate Java record bundles for multi-live-out extract-method regions
wanted_capability: When a Java code-block-to-method extraction has multiple live-out locals, the substrate should be able to synthesize a private/static record or equivalent result object, rewrite the extracted helper to return it, and thread field accesses back to the caller transactionally.
fallback_used: The probe stopped at the planner refusal instead of hand-composing the record and broad rewrite.
notes: Generic finding from a private Java UI-builder probe: extract_java_code_block_to_method correctly identified multiple live-out locals and refused with error.multi_return_needs_record. The missing capability is reusable and should stay private-code agnostic.
